# Resolve an issue in the social-network project

Confirm the issue belongs to this repository and map it to the [active tracker](../../docs/social-network/ticket-tracker.md) and [Zone01 requirements](../../docs/social-network/requirements.md). Reproduce a code defect when applicable, make the scoped fix, run the relevant verification gate, and summarize evidence with the [PR template](../pull_request_template.md). Use the actual configured remote and issue details; the archived forum Gitea account, repository and batch workflow do not apply.
